{{Top|leg}}
An '''anti-grav pool''' was a piece of recreation equipment used for a form of swimming. [[Drevin]] manufactured standard sized anti-grav pools. The [[Holiday Towers Hotel and Casino|Holiday Towers]] [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] maintained an anti-grav pool with lessons being given to guests on an [[Standard hour/Legends|hourly]] basis.
